description: This Java class `GroupReadPlatformServiceImpl` implements the `GroupReadPlatformService` interface and provides methods for retrieving group data, templates, and paginated lists, interacting with the database using JDBC and handling business logic related to groups within a financial system.

classes.name: GroupLookupDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to GroupGeneralData objects, specifically for lookup operations within the group repository.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Prepares a template data object for creating or editing a group, with options for offices, centers, staff, and roles.

methods.name: retrievePagedAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of groups based on search and pagination parameters, with support for sorting and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all groups matching search parameters without pagination, with filtering based on user hierarchy and other criteria.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific group by its ID, enforcing security hierarchy constraints.

methods.name: retrieveGroupsForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves simplified group data suitable for lookup purposes, filtered by office ID.

methods.name: retrieveGroupWithClosureReasons
methods.description: Retrieves group data along with possible closure reasons (code values).

methods.name: retrieveGroupAndMembersDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed group data including associated members, calendars, and roles.
